name: Rheurdt (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of blue with a yellow pale in the lower two thirds, the upper third charged with the shieldless municipal arms of Rheurdt, a white stag's head beneath three yellow figures.
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Düsseldorf of 11 August 1970 the municipality of Rheurdt was approved to bear arms, a seal and a banner, described as blue, gold (yellow) and blue striped lengthwise 1:2:1 with the shieldless figures of the arms in the upper third.

features.role: blue-yellow-blue stripes in the lower two thirds
stag's head beneath three yellow figures
